rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: The existing accepted Latin p@n Niese numbering, confirmed by its stable xml:id. No Niese milestone elements occur in this source.
rules.textTransformations: Trim only citation-unit edge whitespace. Preserve all literal running characters, spelling, punctuation, internal whitespace, bracket notation, asterisks and Greek fragments. Generate no characters.
rules.editorialMarkup: Retain the literal content of add and preserve its source identity in UTF-16 editorialMarks. Do not silently reinterpret add as supplied, or insert punctuation into the indexed text.
rules.quotationAndLanguageMarkup: Preserve q and foreign spans in sourceMarkup and the extraction audit. No quotation marks, spaces or language substitutions are generated.
rules.pageMarkers: pb contributes no characters or spaces, including the word-internal break praecel/pb/lentes in II.186.
rules.chapterMarkers: Boysen chapter milestones contribute no characters. They are independent of Niese units; chapter 10 starts inside II.120.
rules.asteriskMarkers: Preserve each maximal literal asterisk cluster (asterisks optionally separated by whitespace) in textGaps. Its start is a phraseBreaks UTF-16 offset. This is a conservative search barrier, not a new editorial adjudication of every marker.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Phrases cannot cross literal asterisk clusters, including clusters at unit edges. I.119 and I.147 also retain breakBefore from their explicit preceding-lacuna annotations. Ordinary consecutive Niese sections are joinable in whole-book scope; distinct books never join. Boolean conditions may relate text on either side of a marker.
rules.nonlinearAlignment: The accepted Latin II.277–278 sequence is retained without rearrangement, duplication or a phrase barrier. The documented overlap with Greek numbering is not a Latin textual gap.
rules.sourceAnnotations: Retain the two preceding-lacuna annotations and II.68 transcription-restoration-is without reopening their accepted editorial decisions.
rules.gapsAndUnknownContent: No TEI gap, supplied, del, unclear, app, choice or running-text note occurs. Unknown substantive markup or attributes stop extraction for review.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText and recordText offsets are zero-based Python Unicode-character offsets, end exclusive. Record editorialMarks, sourceMarkup, textGaps and phraseBreaks use zero-based JavaScript UTF-16 offsets. Structural markers supply both coordinate types explicitly.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Every indexed character comes from parsed source text. Source projection equals final record text; edge whitespace restores the exact original paragraph.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start, L/M/N continuation; original word strings, including the source's Greek fragments, without normalization or stemming.
rules.readerRouteEvidence: assets/js/renderTei.js: Contra Apionem uses the Boysen Latin source by default; sectionLevelUsesNiese and URL handling accept the existing paragraph Niese identity.
